title: Love in quest
author: Afruja Akhtar
text:
Seductive clouds draw near
Dark wings unfold, whispers clear
Enchanted, mystic snare
In your arms, my hands entwine
Empty moments, time`s disarray
Intoxicating kisses seal our sway
Two souls entwined, trembling free
Tangled locks bind me to thee
Lost in passion, I succumb
To memories, a futile quest
A captivating, sweet deceit.
stanzas: In your arms, my hands entwine
Tangled locks bind me to thee
